summary: The three-slab massing and inset/overhang relationship read correctly and proportions are broadly in line with the photo, but two structural problems block progression: the four required bronze L-brackets are completely missing from the build (a mustMatch fail), and there is an unexplained floating protrusion above the tabletop near the right panel that has no counterpart in the reference.
